svg.aria-label: DeepSeek-V3 training performance across Megatron updates on Blackwell. Published benchmark releases 25.07 through 26.08.01. Model TFLOP/s/GPU increases from 606 to 1,277 on GB200 (2.1 times) and from 1,088 to 1,636 on GB300 (1.5 times). Runs use 256 GPUs and sequence length 4,096. Published recipe configurations vary across versions. Performance summary: https://docs.nvidia.com/nemo/megatron-bridge/0.7.0/performance-summary.html.
